actual: MA-E16 frozen-prediction 1min TWAP execution-parity canary completed with exit 0 but every day had count=0/deal_amount=0 and ffr/pa/pos=NaN. Root cause: qe_suspend_filter_score_weighted_strategy._has_close_price evaluates the minute Exchange at the outer daily decision interval, so _filter_scores_without_close removes all candidates before order generation. Fix must preserve suspend/risk fail-closed behavior, validate minute NestedExecutor outer-day semantics, and reject silent zero-trade false success where applicable. No backend process control, DDL/DML, dependency install, or backtest database data plane.
